# Build of the imported O2 subset and of the fv0sim program.
#
# The upstream O2 build needs many packages that the FV0 simulation does
# not use. This project builds only the imported files, with the upstream
# library split (see o2libs.cmake, generated by tools/gen-o2-cmake.py).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(O2Subset LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(O2_SOURCE_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Imported O2 sources (extern/o2)")
set(FAIRMQ_SOURCE_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Imported FairMQ headers (extern/fairmq)")
set(RAPIDJSON_SOURCE_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Imported RapidJSON (extern/rapidjson)")
set(MSGSL_SOURCE_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Imported Microsoft GSL (extern/ms_gsl)")
set(FLATSIM_APP_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Directory of fv0sim.cxx")
set(FLATSIM_HARNESS_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Directory of the harness tools")
option(FLATSIM_STATIC "Static O2 libraries, linked whole into the programs (T2b)" OFF)

include(GNUInstallDirs)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}")
set(CMAKE_BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH OFF)

find_package(ROOT CONFIG REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core RIO Tree Hist Geom GeomPainter EG Physics MathCore GenVector)
find_package(VMC CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(Geant4 CONFIG REQUIRED)
if(FLATSIM_STATIC)
  include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../hooks/geant4-static-aliases.cmake")
endif()
# geant4_vmc links VGM (Geant4 native navigation, T5a).
find_package(VGM CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(Geant4VMC CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(Pythia8 CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(FairLogger CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(fmt CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(TBB CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(FlatsimBoost CONFIG REQUIRED)

# All external code the O2 libraries see. Over-linking does not change the
# code that runs; it only simplifies this build file.
add_library(o2_external INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(o2_external SYSTEM INTERFACE
  ${FAIRMQ_SOURCE_DIR}
  ${RAPIDJSON_SOURCE_DIR}/include
  ${MSGSL_SOURCE_DIR}/include
  ${Geant4_INCLUDE_DIRS}
  ${Geant4VMC_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(o2_external INTERFACE
  ROOT::Core ROOT::RIO ROOT::Tree ROOT::Hist ROOT::Geom ROOT::GeomPainter ROOT::EG ROOT::Physics
  ROOT::MathCore ROOT::GenVector
  VMCLibrary
  ${Geant4_LIBRARIES}
  ${Geant4VMC_LIBRARIES}
  Pythia8::pythia8
  FairLogger::FairLogger fmt::fmt
  TBB::tbb
  Boost::headers Boost::program_options)

# One shared library libO2<name>.so per upstream O2 library, with its
# ROOT dictionary, as in an O2 installation. With FLATSIM_STATIC, one static
# library each.
if(FLATSIM_STATIC)
  set(o2_lib_kind STATIC)
else()
  set(o2_lib_kind SHARED)
endif()
function(o2_library name)
  cmake_parse_arguments(A "" "DIR" "SOURCES;DEPENDS;DICTIONARY" ${ARGN})
  set(target O2${name})
  set(dir "${O2_SOURCE_DIR}/${A_DIR}")
  list(TRANSFORM A_SOURCES PREPEND "${dir}/")
  list(TRANSFORM A_DEPENDS PREPEND "O2")
  add_library(${target} ${o2_lib_kind} ${A_SOURCES})
  set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
  add_library(${name} ALIAS ${target})
  target_include_directories(${target} PUBLIC ${O2_INCLUDE_DIRS} PRIVATE "${dir}/src")
  target_link_libraries(${target} PUBLIC o2_external ${A_DEPENDS})
  if(A_DICTIONARY)
    list(TRANSFORM A_DICTIONARY PREPEND "${dir}/")
    root_generate_dictionary(G__${target} ${A_DICTIONARY}
      MODULE ${target}
      LINKDEF "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/linkdef/${name}LinkDef.h"
      OPTIONS -inlineInputHeader -noGlobalUsingStd)
    install(FILES
      "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/lib${target}_rdict.pcm"
      "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/lib${target}.rootmap"
      DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR})
  endif()
  install(TARGETS ${target} LIBRARY DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR} ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR})
endfunction()

include(o2libs.cmake)

# Upstream: GENERATORS_WITH_PYTHIA8 is set when Pythia 8 is found.
# GENERATORS_WITH_TPCLOOPERS stays off: the TPC looper generator needs
# ONNX Runtime and the CCDB, and the FV0 simulation does not use it.
target_compile_definitions(O2Generators PUBLIC GENERATORS_WITH_PYTHIA8)
# Upstream compiles the FairRoot copy with warnings off.
target_compile_options(O2FairRootBase PRIVATE -w)

add_executable(fv0sim "${FLATSIM_APP_DIR}/fv0sim.cxx")
# The upstream library dependencies pass through libraries that this build
# does not have, so fv0sim links all O2 libraries directly.
get_property(o2_targets DIRECTORY PROPERTY BUILDSYSTEM_TARGETS)
list(FILTER o2_targets INCLUDE REGEX "^O2")
if(FLATSIM_STATIC)
  # Nothing references the ROOT dictionaries in the archives, so the linker
  # would drop them. WHOLE_ARCHIVE keeps them, and their static
  # initializers register the classes with ROOT.
  # The archives come in again as normal dependencies, so CMake's
  # WHOLE_ARCHIVE feature is not allowed; explicit linker options are.
  set(whole_archives ${o2_targets} VMCLibrary ${Geant4VMC_LIBRARIES})
  list(TRANSFORM whole_archives REPLACE "(.+)" "$<TARGET_FILE:\\1>")
  target_compile_definitions(fv0sim PRIVATE FLATSIM_STATIC)
  target_link_options(fv0sim PRIVATE LINKER:--whole-archive ${whole_archives} LINKER:--no-whole-archive)
  target_link_libraries(fv0sim PRIVATE ${o2_targets})
else()
  list(REMOVE_ITEM o2_targets O2G4Setup)
  target_link_libraries(fv0sim PRIVATE ${o2_targets})
endif()
install(TARGETS fv0sim RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR})

# Harness tool: reads the simulation output through ROOT I/O only.
add_executable(fv0dump "${FLATSIM_HARNESS_DIR}/fv0dump.cxx")
if(FLATSIM_STATIC)
  target_link_options(fv0dump PRIVATE LINKER:--whole-archive ${whole_archives} LINKER:--no-whole-archive)
  target_link_libraries(fv0dump PRIVATE ${o2_targets})
else()
  target_link_libraries(fv0dump PRIVATE DataFormatsFV0 SimulationDataFormat)
endif()
install(TARGETS fv0dump RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR})

if(FLATSIM_STATIC)
  # A dictionary linked into a program looks for its PCM file next to the
  # program, not in lib/. Link the PCM files of the static libraries there.
  install(CODE [[
    file(GLOB pcms "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib/libO2*_rdict.pcm"
                   "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib/libVMCLibrary_rdict.pcm"
                   "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib/libgeant4vmc_rdict.pcm"
                   "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib/libg4root_rdict.pcm"
                   "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib/libmtroot_rdict.pcm")
    foreach(pcm IN LISTS pcms)
      get_filename_component(name "${pcm}" NAME)
      file(CREATE_LINK "../lib/${name}" "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/bin/${name}" SYMBOLIC)
    endforeach()
  ]])
endif()

# Run time data, at the same place below share/ as in an O2 installation.
set(share "${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}")
install(DIRECTORY "${O2_SOURCE_DIR}/Detectors/Geometry" DESTINATION "${share}/Detectors")
install(FILES "${O2_SOURCE_DIR}/Detectors/gconfig/g4config.in" DESTINATION "${share}/Detectors/gconfig")
install(DIRECTORY "${O2_SOURCE_DIR}/Detectors/gconfig/data" DESTINATION "${share}/Detectors/gconfig")
install(DIRECTORY "${O2_SOURCE_DIR}/Common/maps" DESTINATION "${share}/Common")
install(DIRECTORY "${O2_SOURCE_DIR}/Detectors/FIT/FV0/simulation/data" DESTINATION "${share}/Detectors/FV0/simulation")
install(DIRECTORY "${O2_SOURCE_DIR}/Detectors/Passive/data" DESTINATION "${share}/Detectors/Passive/simulation")
install(FILES "${O2_SOURCE_DIR}/run/o2simdefaultdetectorlist.json" DESTINATION "${share}/config")
install(FILES "${O2_SOURCE_DIR}/Generators/share/pythia8/decays/base.cfg" DESTINATION "${share}/Generators/pythia8/decays")
